title: DodagState.__post_init__ does not coerce node_address; string form bypasses RFC 6550 self-parent rejection
description:
## Location

`python/src/lichen/rpl/dodag.py` `DodagState.__post_init__` (coerces `dodag_id` and copies `parents`, not `node_address`) and `process_dio` self-parent check (`neighbor_id == self.node_address` after `to_ipv6(neighbor_id)`).

## What goes wrong

`as_root()` and `process_dio(neighbor_id=...)` both accept `IPv6Address | str` and coerce via `to_ipv6`. The dataclass constructor does not. `node_address` is typed `IPv6Address | None` but is stored as-is.

`ipaddress.IPv6Address('fe80::1234') == 'fe80::1234'` is False. A node constructed with a string `node_address` therefore fails the RFC 6550 Section 8.2.2.5 self-parent check and will install itself as preferred parent.

Trigger (public API, same string style as `dodag_id=DODAG_ID` and `process_dio(..., \"fe80::1234\")`):

```
own = \"fe80::1234\"
node = DodagState(rpl_instance_id=0, dodag_id=\"fd00::1\", version=1, node_address=own)
node.process_dio(DIO(..., rank=256), own, link_etx=1.0)
```

Expected: ignored, stays UNJOINED (what `test_process_dio_rejects_self_as_parent_string_form` asserts for IPv6Address `node_address`).
Actual: JOINED, `preferred_parent == IPv6Address('fe80::1234')`, rank 512.

`test_process_dio_rejects_self_as_parent_string_form` only passes a string *neighbor_id* with an IPv6Address *node_address*, so this path is untested.

## Fix

Coerce `node_address` in `__post_init__` the same way as `dodag_id` (skip when None). Compare after both sides are `IPv6Address`.
